refresh: hand-maintained from live LeadSquared API discovery — see docs/coverage/LSQ_DISCOVERY_2026-09-11.md and docs/coverage/LSQ_VERIFICATION_2026-09-11.md

booking_created.note: ActivityEvent 206 — primary commitment signal, NOT yet the authoritative conversion definition

post_booking_order_status.note: ActivityEvent 208 — 0..N rows per booking; Booking Status progresses pending -> confirmed/customer_confirmed -> completed

facebook_lead_ads_submissions.note: ActivityEvent 204 — corroborating Meta attribution source, captured at submission time

opportunities.note: Deliberately excluded — a live 'Won' opportunity's amount/booking-id/customer-id were byte-for-byte identical to the same booking's 206 record (a mirror, not an independent revenue source). LSQ_VERIFICATION_2026-09-11.md §A.

payment_success_activity.note: ActivityEvent 225 deliberately excluded — covers <1% of bookings in the verified account, not the real payment signal. LSQ_VERIFICATION_2026-09-11.md §C.

mx_source_campaign_id.note: Google campaign / Meta campaign fallback join key

mx_gclid.note: stored but never used as a warehouse join — Google Ads reporting does not expose GCLID

mx_ad_id.note: Meta ad join key. NOT used for Google — every sampled Google-sourced lead's mx_Ad_Id was Meta-format

mx_adset_id.note: Google ad-group join key; Meta adset join key

mx_utm_keyword_id.note: no Google Ads keyword-level entity exists in this warehouse to join against

mx_lead_type.note: P1/P2/L1/L2/Corporate — new-vs-repeat; not filtered in ingestion, a business decision (§9)

booking_id.note: resolved from a different mx_Custom_N slot per event type (206/208/223), normalised at ingestion

lead_stage_or_status.note: no LeadStage/LeadStatus field exists on the Lead object in this account's schema — lifecycle is tracked entirely through activities

notes: Auth is AuthType.API_KEY (static accessKey/secretKey), not OAuth — see app/connectors/leadsquared/base.py.
No authoritative revenue field, Payment Status semantics, or repeat-customer acquisition policy is modelled yet — deliberately left as an open business decision. LSQ_VERIFICATION_2026-09-11.md §9.
leadsquared_leads and leadsquared_activities are new warehouse tables (record grain, not <source>_performance daily-aggregate grain) — see app/models/warehouse.py.
